metadata.discovery_notes: Trilium Notes v0.103.0. SPA with jQuery widget system (Preact + legacy). Single main route '/' with all content rendered client-side via note tree + dialogs. Settings/options are special notes (_options*) rendered inside a modal. No client-side router — navigation is note-centric via froca cache. _optionsTotp was deleted; TOTP settings are embedded in _optionsPassword (SignInMethod component). New pages (v2 additions): _optionsMedia, _optionsOther, _optionsSpellcheck, _optionsDesktop, import#keep, import#files, backend-log note type, zen-mode layout state, call-to-action dialog, password-not-set dialog, incorrect-cpu-arch dialog, plus generic confirm/info/prompt utility dialogs.
